For the group of items, see [[Royal Guard's Series]].'' {{Infobox Quest |image= File:BotW The Royal Guard's Gear.png |caption= |type= Side |game= BotW |giver= [[Parcy]] |location= Riverside Stable |prereq= |reward= {{Icon List|BotW|Gold Rupee}} |previous= |next= }} "{{Term/Store|The Royal Guard's Gear||Series, BotW}}" is a [[Side Quest]] in {{BotW}}.{{Cite|{{Big|The Royal Guard's Gear}}
{{Color BotW|Side Quest|Riverside Stable}}|Adventure Log|BotW}} ==Overview== "The Royal Guard's Gear" is a [[Side Quest]] offered by [[Parcy]], a [[Hylian]] traveller who resides at the [[Riverside Stable]]. When [[Link]] first meets her, she asks him if he has ever been to [[Hyrule Castle]], explaining that it had fallen to ruin over 100 years ago.{{Cite|Have you gone to the giant castle north of here? That's Hyrule Castle. It's said to have fallen to ruin over a hundred years ago.|Parcy|BotW}} She used to sneak into the Castle herself looking for ancient treasure, only to stop more recently due to the environmental hazards that surround the area.{{Cite|I used to sneak in there to salvage ancient treasures, but it's too dangerous to go in there now. These days it's surrounded by an eerie mist and savage machine-like creatures.|Parcy|BotW}} Back then, Parcy was looking for equipment from the [[Royal Guard's Series]], though she was never able to find any.{{Cite|Back when it was safer, I went in looking for this ultra-rare equipment that once belonged to the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard}}. It's legendary among collectors, but I was never able to find any...|Parcy|BotW}} Link must retrieve at least one piece of the Royal Guard's Series from [[Hyrule Castle (Dungeon)|Hyrule Castle]] to show to Parcy. Upon seeing one of the [[Item]]s, she will recognize it and ask to see it.{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that bow you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that big sword you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that shield you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that spear you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}}{{Cite|Wait just a minute! Can you show me that sword you've got there?!|Parcy|BotW}} After looking at the Item, Parcy will thank Link and express a desire to find one herself.{{Cite|This is...incredible. Thank you. You have shown me something truly spectacular. I need to go out and find one of these myself.|Parcy|BotW}} As a token of her appreciation, she gives Link a [[Gold Rupee]].{{Cite|Here's a token of my appreciation.|Parcy|BotW}} Once this is done, the Side Quest will be complete. ===Objectives=== {{Quest Objectives |- | 1 | Though Hyrule Castle was destroyed 100 years ago, somewhere inside it still sleeps rare equipment from those days. It is famed among collectors as the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard's series}}. Parcy, a traveler at the stable, wants nothing more than to see one of them.

However, the castle is a dangerous place nowadays, and ordinary folk risk their lives getting close... |- | Complete | Though Hyrule Castle was destroyed 100 years ago, you ventured inside and found part of the {{Color BotW|Red|royal guard's series}}, famous among equipment collectors.

When you showed Parcy, the traveler at the stable, she seemed to be more curious about it than ever. Hopefully she won't do anything reckless... }} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Parcy * Riverside Stable * Royal Guard's Series * Side Quest }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |side-quests= BotW }}
